title: Glioma margins gain a third dimension before surgery ends
title_zh: 胶质瘤边缘在手术结束前获得第三维度
abstract: In this issue of Cell, Liu et al. introduce ULTRA, which combines rapid tissue clearing, single-channel stimulated Raman scattering microscopy, and AI to generate cell-resolved three-dimensional virtual histology of intact glioma specimens in about 30 minutes-fast enough to expose depth-dependent infiltration before surgery ends.
abstract_zh: 在本期《Cell》杂志中，刘等人介绍了ULTRA，该技术结合快速组织清除、单通道激发拉曼散射显微镜和人工智能，在约30分钟内生成完整胶质瘤标本的细胞分辨三维虚拟组织学，速度足以在手术结束前揭示深度相关的浸润情况。
snippet: In this issue of Cell, Liu et al. introduce ULTRA, which combines rapid tissue clearing, single-channel stimulated Raman scattering microscopy, and AI to generate cell-resolved three-dimensional virtual histology of intact glioma specimens in about 30 minutes-fast enough to expose depth-dependent infiltration before surgery ends.
